title: Purpose.
bodyText: It is the intent of this chapter to require that only reduced ignition propensity cigarettes be sold in the State. Although these cigarettes are not guaranteed to self-extinguish, they are expected to reduce accidental fires and related personal injury and property damage caused by cigarette smoking.
bodyHtml: [§132C-1]  Purpose.  It is the intent of this chapter to require that only reduced ignition propensity cigarettes be sold in the State.  Although these cigarettes are not guaranteed to self-extinguish, they are expected to reduce accidental fires and related personal injury and property damage caused by cigarette smoking. [L 2008, c 218, pt of §1]
